review.assessment:
The task requires safeJsonParse to never throw and return { ok: false, error } on invalid or empty input. The diff modifies exactly this function, replacing the direct call with a try-catch block that intercepts all exceptions from JSON.parse. This fully covers the stated scope without touching unrelated parts of the codebase.

The change wraps the existing JSON.parse call inside a try-catch block. On success, it returns { ok: true, value } as before. On any exception (including empty strings or malformed JSON), it catches the error and returns { ok: false, error } with a stringified message instead of throwing.
